LanguageData.MinchoCandyWars.Ability.InteledDesc:
Once the smart modification is complete, a Mincho's core grade and body grade can each be raised further, up to grade 5. Core and body grades affect her stats and available abilities; candy ornaments are a separate system that switches ability schools rather than raising grades.
1. Raise body grade: prepare a body booster pack (mint ice cream ×300, components ×4).
2. Raise core grade: use a basic core booster pack for grades 1-3 (mint ice cream ×50, secondary core (basic)); use an advanced core booster pack for grades 3-5 (mint ice cream ×50, secondary core (standard)).
3. Perform the implant: schedule the matching implant surgery on the target Mincho. Booster pack surgery is set to 100% success.
Smart Mincho booster packs can be made at the Mincho workbench or obtained from related quests; faction quests also reward smart booster packs.
